description: This Java class 'UserWorkbookPopulator' is responsible for populating an Excel workbook with user-related data, including setting up sheets, layout, and data validation rules for importing user information in a bulk import process within the Fineract project.

classes.name: UserWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel workbook with user data, setting up sheets, layout, data validation rules, and dynamic named ranges for use in bulk user import operations.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Initializes the user sheet and populates auxiliary sheets for offices, personnel, and roles, then sets up layout and validation rules.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation constraints for specific columns such as Office, Staff Name, and boolean flags.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Creates named ranges in the workbook for office names and staff names, used for dropdown validations.

methods.name: setSanitized
methods.description: Likely a utility to sanitize sheet names for named range validity (not shown but inferred).

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the header row and column widths for the user sheet.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes specified header text into a row and column (assumed utility method).
